verdict.rationale: Docs show concrete bulk-operation support: REST/GraphQL batching up to 60 records per request (with batch upsert in GraphQL), unlimited API import for large-scale migrations, CSV/XLSX bulk import with field mapping and error handling, and workflow Iterator/Code nodes for looping over records. The 60-record-per-request cap and lack of hands-on community confirmation of true bulk-at-scale performance are caveats.
